title: EHSINV-25: Environmental Health & Safety Investigation Services
agency_path: City of New York > Environmental Protection
description_text: This Request for Proposal (RFx) is being released through PASSPort, New York Citys online procurement portal. Responses to this RFx should be submitted via PASSPort. To access the solicitation, vendors should visit the PASSPort Public Portal at https://www1.nyc.gov/site/mocs/systems/about-go-to-passport.page and click on the Search Funding Opportunities in PASSPort blue box. This will take you to the Public Portal of all procurements in the PASSPort system. To quickly locate the RFx, insert the EPIN: 82626P0018 into the Keywords search field. Anyone requiring assistance from the MOCS Service Desk should use their inquiry Submission Form: https://mocssupport.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/8
